title: Paged completed-session archive route and UI archive view: browse finished sessions without knowing their id
outcome: Per Greg's direction that audit/history stays reachable through a separate paginated archive route: a new cursor-paged route lists completed sessions (roots and delegation children) that are outside the live projection, filterable by project, kind and completion time. A UI archive view lists them and opens one through the existing per-session history route. Nothing is deleted.
acceptance: A new GET route returns completed sessions outside the live projection in a stable order with a bounded limit and an opaque cursor, filterable by project, kind (root or delegation child) and completion range; malformed cursors and limits are refused; tests cover paging, filters and stability under concurrent completion.

A UI archive view lists that route page by page and opens a selected session's transcript through the existing GET /api/sessions/{id}/history, without adding it to the live snapshot; focused UI tests cover listing, paging and opening.
The docs describe the route and view; the full gate passes on the exact committed tree with a clean independent review pair.
